Rules.Title: Resolution rules
Rules.Order: Order: validate → pay costs → shape → attack roll → native weapon mastery → damage → one secondary effect → Momentum → reactions.
Rules.Attack: Forge attack bonuses total at most +2 per roll; penalties always apply.
Rules.Damage: Flat Forge damage totals at most your proficiency bonus; one rider die per hit; one damage type change; nothing multiplies damage except native critical hits.
Rules.Secondary: At most one Forge secondary effect per hit (you choose); native mastery is separate.
Rules.Momentum: Momentum gains: at most 2 per round in total, each source once per turn or round; a technique can never generate as much Momentum as it costs.
Rules.Triggers: Triggered effects can't trigger further effects; techniques never trigger from other techniques.
Rules.Magic: One weave per spell. Weaves never create or refund spell slots and never remove Concentration.
